body:
Tested this on my setup (RTX 3060, 610.43.03, KDE Wayland) using the linux-editor artifact from the build.  https://github.com/godotengine/godot/actions/runs/30542588752?pr=121935#artifacts

With GODOT_WAYLAND_DISABLE_NATIVE_FIFO=1 the editor no longer locks up when I follow the reproduction steps here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/114986#issuecomment-4040605825 

I open the embedded game view, an additional floating window (shader editor), and an add new node third window with a tooltip.  This seems to fix the issue I've been chasing.

Name seems fine to me, it lines up with the other GODOT_WAYLAND_DISABLE_* vars (_GODOT_WAYLAND_DISABLE_EMBEDDER_ and _GODOT_WAYLAND_DISABLE_LIBDECOR_) but I think it will be hard for people to discover this env var unless we have it somewhere in the docs discussing the issue with the embedded game window + wayland on Linux (no idea where to put this).

I'll be closing my PR since I think this is a cleaner fix, and splitting up the functionality in mine for a future PR. I'm still caution about the embedded game window waiting for an infinite timeout. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121712/changes#diff-ac761c053900e0193a64c661b1987447639d609edbef80ac701a4229f192a9e6L4026

Thanks for your effort on this!
👍🏻
